purpose: Disposition of Swiss active dossiers that cannot be promoted to complete without guessing or extrapolating tariffs.
policy: Set aside only after direct/official or current public-source avenues fail to provide an exact deterministic retail tariff. Set-aside is not complete and preserves the unresolved scope for later evidence.

dossiers.reason: Six public EVSEs remain in Basel-Landschaft. The official Basel-Stadt tariff overlay was deliberately limited to its exact published scope; no reliable exact public direct tariff was found for Münchenstein, Pratteln or Muttenz/Birsfelden sites.

Eponet explicitly states that charging prices and blocking/parking fees are set by each infrastructure operator. The targeted eCarUp audit found priced nearby candidates but no safely resolvable exact match; applying a network-wide price would be extrapolation.
Sahli/Glattalp remains direct-capable in the current national feed, but public sources conflict on the actual ad-hoc tariff/payment path. No tariff is guessed.

All eight current EVTEC-scope EVSEs advertise Direct Payment, but no authoritative current station retail tariff was found for all three locations. Hardware/product pricing is not a charging tariff and third-party ad-hoc values are not promoted as direct CPO evidence.
The Dietikon EVSE advertises Direct Payment but no current authoritative exact charging tariff is published in the available direct sources.
The Herrliberg EVSE advertises Direct Payment but no current authoritative exact charging tariff is published in the available direct sources.

The three remaining EVSEs are publicly accessible but have no authentication/payment metadata in the national feed. Current station directories do not expose a deterministic Partino direct retail tariff; physical accessibility is not interpreted as free charging.

After direct Swisscharge tariff collection and explicit restricted/no-auth classification, 44 CH*SUI-prefix EVSEs remain direct-source gaps. The 59 owner-scope records with non-SUI prefixes were separately queried and returned 404, so they are not imported into CH*SUI tariff scope.
Tesla charging is maintained by the dedicated Tesla source/pipeline in TCC V9 rather than the non-Tesla CPO tariff ledger.
User-requested set-aside pending AVIA VOLT app/Charles capture and exact Deftpower tariff backend access.
